typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Member_Number as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT convert(varchar(30),MC.Subscriber_ID + \'00\')  AS \'Member_Number\' FROM P_MEMBER_HRA PMH WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN MEMBER M WITH (NOLOCK) ON  PMH.CID = M.CID INNER JOIN MEMBER_COVERAGE MC WITH (NOLOCK) ON M.CID = MC.CID WHERE SYSTEM_DATE > DATEADD(Month, -7, GETDATE()) AND HRA_ID IN (1662,2034) AND STATUS in (2,3) Aborted',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> CareAdvanceScreenings
CareAdvanceScreenings derive(MemberNumber = substring(toString(Member_Number), toInteger(1), toInteger(30))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(MemberNumber = MemberNumber) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount1
PlaceHolderRowCount1 sink(input(
		CALLLIST_303_CA_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CALLLIST_303_CA_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = MemberNumber)) ~> PDSCAScreeningStaging
